## In plain words

The R4 shortlist rests on choices: which weights, which minutes threshold, how to mix similarity and
price, which budget. This step reruns the whole analysis {{named.scenarios}} times, each time changing
one of those choices, and {{draws.draws}} more times with randomly shaken group weights. A player who
stays in the top {{settings.top_n}} under most of them does not owe his place to one particular
assumption. All scenarios, the line for the "robust core" and the rule that picks the recommendation
were written in `config/sensitivity.yaml` before any result was seen.

Fingerprints (sha256): `config/sensitivity.yaml` `{{fp_sens}}`;
base `config/similarity.yaml` `{{fp_sim}}` (the same file as R4; the base
scenario reproduces the R4 shortlist exactly, checked on every run).
